POST-QUANTUM ENCRYPTION - Kyber768 (ML-KEM-768) + AES-256-GCM
========================================================================
Date (UTC):   2026-10-03 22:49:12
Machine:      Darwin 27.0.0 (arm64)
Python:       3.9.6
PQC software: github.com/pq-crystals/kyber @ 3edd5af5991927164edd4aacebfcbee00b8064e7 (ref/)

Kyber is a key encapsulation mechanism: it lets two parties agree on a
secret key that is safe against quantum computers. That 32-byte key is
then used with AES-256-GCM to encrypt the message itself.
